criteria.detail: The guide's rate table and worked bills, recomputed from its own steps and compared with the sector pages: 48 rows, 48 read on both sides and reconciled; 44 agree, 4 disagree. The 4 that disagree are errors in the Ministry's guide 'How to calculate your quota and levy bill' (the source document), where the guide contradicts its own steps or the sector page; they are not errors in this reading. Listed from the rows: rate marine/ONE/HS printed/page 350 vs computed/guide 300; p15 factory T2 levy printed/page 5160 vs computed/guide 5640; p15 factory total printed/page 13280 vs computed/guide 13760; p15 cafe + factory total printed/page 14580 vs computed/guide 15060. The flag reads that every row is present and reconciled; the list is this check's output.
criteria.name: L3-2

criteria.detail: HS and BS are both written and differ at 12 of 12 positions; positions writing more than two classes (Unskilled added): construction/MNP 3 classes, 3 distinct values, construction/NTS 3 classes, 2 distinct values. services 6 cells 5 distinct; manufacturing 6 cells 6 distinct; construction 8 cells 6 distinct; process 4 cells 4 distinct; marine 2 cells 2 distinct; all Work Permit cells 15 distinct values; S Pass current 1 value (650), before 2025-09-01 2 values (550, 650).
criteria.name: L3-3

criteria.detail: Squares (BS-HS)@a-(BS-HS)@b in SGD (floor 1) and log(BS/HS) difference (floor log((x+1)/x)), every pair of positions within a table, 10 squares, 7 independent (b1 = E - V + 1 per table: services 2, manufacturing 2, construction 2, process 1; dependent: services T2 vs T3, manufacturing T2 vs T3, construction NTS vs OFF): services T1 vs T2 -50 / +0.0000 [one composition zero]; services T1 vs T3 -50 / +0.1178 [compositions of opposite sign]; services T2 vs T3 +0 / +0.1178 [one composition zero]; manufacturing T1 vs T2 +0 / +0.0972 [one composition zero]; manufacturing T1 vs T3 +20 / +0.2250 [both compositions nonzero, same sign]; manufacturing T2 vs T3 +20 / +0.1277 [both compositions nonzero, same sign]; construction MNP vs NTS +0 / +0.2595 [one composition zero]; construction MNP vs OFF +280 / +0.4553 [both compositions nonzero, same sign]; construction NTS vs OFF +280 / +0.1957 [both compositions nonzero, same sign]; process MNP vs NTS -100 / +0.0377 [compositions of opposite sign]. Rival shapes, read on whole tables: bare (one value per position) fails at 12/12 positions; additive (class term + position term) fails on 4/4 tables (services, manufacturing, construction, process); multiplicative fails on 4/4 tables (services, manufacturing, construction, process). Single squares where a rival's zero holds: additive services T2 vs T3, manufacturing T1 vs T2, construction MNP vs NTS; multiplicative services T1 vs T2.

criteria.detail: Increment in the monthly bill from one more hire, computed from the guide's steps over mixes within quota, LQS 1..80: services S Pass [650, 750, 800, 850, 950, 1000], manufacturing S Pass [650, 750, 930, 950]; the printed S Pass rate is one number, 650. Sets identical at all knob points: True. Flag (S Pass maximum above 650) holds at 4/4 knob points (L=1..40 step 1, L=1..80 step 1, L=1..80 step 0.5, whole quota region).
